static_traits.name: Zhang Mei
static_traits.family_status: No immediate family members, living alone
static_traits.social_status: Has a few casual acquaintances, but Relationship tension with others due to self-isolation
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history, no past psychotherapy/psychiatric visits
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to identify own thinking patterns, highly cooperative; tense but manageable emotions, tending toward harsh self-evaluation

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently believe I am the worst at free throws and three-pointers, related to being Fired by a professional basketball team after graduation, producing strong feelings of worthlessness and Self-doubt, gradually avoiding all basketball-related activities and doubting other life domains too.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent feelings of worthlessness and Self-doubt have started affecting my daily life and overall mental health, prompting me to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: After Graduated from university, was recruited to play professional basketball, then was fired. This dealt a major blow to self-esteem, forming the belief 'I am the worst', triggering persistent feelings of worthlessness and Self-doubt, followed by Avoiding basketball-related activities and lacking confidence in other domains too.

Excellent academic performance during university and graduating with honors, having served as class representative, experiencing pride and a sense of competence at that time, feeling that goals can be achieved as long as one works hard.

core_beliefs: I am worthless/I am a failure
My worth depends entirely on my performance in basketball

special_situations.event: Fired by a professional basketball team after graduation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am fired, it means I am the least capable and worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids all basketball-related activities; at the same time tries to prove oneself through online tutorials and practice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just the worst; I am worthless

special_situations.event: Missing a shot during training or games (free throws/three-pointers missing)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I miss one shot, it proves I am a lousy player and will never get better
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-reproach, a frustrated mindset, possibly reducing practice or rushing to practice more
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am lousy, I will never get better

special_situations.event: Preparing to apply for jobs or thinking about career plans
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failing at basketball, which I love, means I will also fail in other areas
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating on resume submissions and interviews, avoiding attempts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will surely fail again; better not try

special_situations.event: Facing social invitations or thinking about discussing Self-doubt with acquaintances
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I voice these, they will not understand or will judge me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing, choosing self-isolation to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me / think I am awful

core_conflict.wish: Longing to Gaining recognition and acceptance through outstanding performance, maintaining self-worth
core_conflict.fear: Fear of failure being negated and humiliated, being seen as utterly worthless
defense_goal: Avoids being judged to maintain a sense of safety
Maintains short-term emotional stability through avoidance

object_relations.self_representation: I am a failure/someone not worthy of recognition

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor inquires into the details of being fired or tries to clarify and define one's abilities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling judged, worrying the counselor also thinks I am not good enough
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone becoming cautious, giving vague overviews, avoiding key details, using fuzzy words (e.g., 'maybe' 'should'), reducing eye contact.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to set concrete actions (such as practicing again, submitting resumes) and follow through on them
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Once an action fails it will completely prove my utter worthlessness
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Raises objective limitations (time, resources) as reasons to postpone action, giving long explanations in a calm, rational tone while avoiding present emotional experience.

manifestations: Self-isolating for fear of judgment, Reduced socializing and asking for help
outcomes: Worsening negative emotions and lowered self-worth

manifestations: My beloved basketball career is frustrated; after being fired, my self-worth and life direction are impacted
Lacking motivation for job-seeking and self-care
outcomes: Holding negative Anticipation toward the future

positive_force: Continuously achieved success during the university stage (graduated with honors, served as class representative), with experiences of competence and pride
Able to identify own thinking patterns and their impact, willing to Reflection
Proactively seeks help, positive attitude, willing to try cognitive restructuring and gratitude practice
Has proactively tried improving skills through online tutorials and practice, with self-help motivation
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking are significant
Self-labeling and self-worth overly dependent on external performance and evaluation
Avoidance and procrastination (avoiding basketball, job hunting, and socializing)
Insufficient self-care and disordered routines causing low energy and Decreased motivation
Negative Anticipation of others and mind-reading worries (fear of being judged)

antecedent: Thinking of or encountering basketball, courts, training
Recalling the experience of being fired
target_behavior.core_reason: Interpreting being fired as 'I am the worst', with Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking triggering shame and Fear of failure
target_behavior.function: Evades the painful emotions brought by being judged and failing again
target_behavior.consequence: Losing sports and career-related opportunities, self-efficacy further declining

antecedent: Preparing to send resumes or browse job listings
Facing the possibility of an interview
target_behavior.core_reason: Generalizing basketball failure to other domains, predicting future failure
target_behavior.function: Short-term relief from Anxiety and sense of failure
target_behavior.consequence: Ongoing Unemployment, financial strain and Impaired self-esteem

antecedent: Friends or acquaintances extending social invitations
Thinking about discussing Self-doubt and feelings of worthlessness
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading inferences that others will judge oneself, producing shame
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension, weakened support system, intensified loneliness

antecedent: Intensified negative rumination at night, Low mood periods
target_behavior.core_reason: Damaged sense of worth and Insufficient motivation, negative cycle maintained
target_behavior.function: Passively avoids tasks and emotions for short-term relief
target_behavior.consequence: Energy declines; mood and motivation worsen further
